results.title: Truck industry overview – 2026 edition - Automotive World
results.content: # Truck industry overview – 2026 edition. Automotive World examines the state of the global truck industry, including sales, market demand, production and profitability. Global sales of 6t-plus trucks were on a rising trend for more than 20 years as a CAGR of 3.85% took demand from 1.49 million units in 1996 to an all-time peak of 3.43 million in 2018. The 2022 fall was accentuated by a change in the data source for China (see comments in Asia section). A return to double-digit growth in 2023 took demand to 2.9 million units, close to the average for the previous ten years, as was the 2024 figure of 2.8 million units. In 2025, the global market for 6t-plus trucks rose by about 4% as declines in Europe (especially Russia) and North America were more than offset by increases elsewhere, particularly China and India. | *Incr / (Decr.) %* | *7.6* | *4.1* | *(2.1)* | *(22.2)* | *17.7* | *0.5* | *26.8* | *(6.2)* | *(18.0)* | *2.9* |.
